name: docs-particles-gpu-verified
title: Docs: particles page records the manual GPU verification and drops the stale 'Vulkan is stubs' and 'not confirmed by a run' claims
issue: Docs-only fix. docs/particles.html (the 'Not verified in CI' callout around lines 294-298 on master) is stale in two ways: (1) it says the PhysX driver's assumptions are 'from memory of PhysX 5.6.1 and not confirmed by a run' and that the GPU test and checklist 'are what check them': the maintainer HAS now run the GPU golden test and the manual checklist (docs/gpu-particles-checklist.html) on a Windows PC with an NVIDIA GPU on 2026-10-14 and reported that it WORKED. Rewrite that paragraph to say exactly that and no more: the real PhysX driver is still never run in CI (it needs a CUDA context), but it was verified manually by the maintainer on a Windows GPU PC on 2026-10-14 (GPU golden test + checklist passed); the points listed (device pointers updated by host-to-device copy plus raiseFlags, buffer order, setNbActiveParticles/flags between steps, release order) are what that run exercised; be HONEST about what was NOT recorded: no VRAM figures, timings, or tuning of the water/sand/smoke presets were captured (the presets remain untuned), and nothing was verified on other GPUs/drivers or on Linux (the Linux GPU asset is deferred). Keep the list of what remains unverified (other vendors/drivers, Linux GPU, performance) and keep the link to the checklist. (2) it says 'The Vulkan renderer, which is still stubs': on master the Vulkan renderer now has a headless core (stage 0), resource creation (stage A) and, once PR #144 merges, unlit draws (stage B) but still has NO blending, text or swapchain, so particles (additive/alpha-blended billboards) do not draw on Vulkan yet: reword that sentence accordingly WITHOUT claiming more than master has (check docs/application.html and git log origin/master for the current Vulkan status wording and stay consistent with it; do not mention PR #144 if it is not merged yet when you start; if it IS merged, say unlit meshes draw but blending/text do not). Also grep docs/physics.html, docs/soft-bodies.html, docs/gpu-particles-checklist.html, docs/index.html and docs/testing.html for the same two stale claims and fix them the same way (minimal edits; keep the existing HTML style, badges and CRLF/LF per file: check the file's line endings before editing and keep the diff small). Do not change any other page content. Nothing builds locally; CI is the build (8 checks, required `linux (Release, x86_64, Clang)`). Check the final diff is only the intended sentences.
acceptance: particles.html records the manual GPU verification honestly (what was and was not recorded)
No page claims the Vulkan renderer is still all stubs
Diff limited to the stale sentences
notes: Reviewer: make sure no claim goes beyond what the user reported ('the GPU test and checklist worked on the Windows GPU PC', no numbers recorded) and that Vulkan wording matches master. Docs only.
